summary: Read auto-resolved asks and replace their defaults through client-v0

replay.detail: Reads derive from existing claims. Overrides use the native exact-episode idempotent person override path.

schema.detail: Client-v0 adds AutoResolvedAsk, AutoResolvedAsks, PersonOverrideParameters, auto-resolved.list and work.override. No persisted claim schema or corpus changes.

compatibility.detail: Person-only read.projections reads return at most 128 recent rows over 512 person-indexed ask candidates, with complete=false on truncation. Optional default_answer, request and action_parameters are omitted, never null. Generated Rust, Swift and TypeScript clients expose the read and action. Open attention rows do not offer override.

manual.detail: Clients re-read on opening, attention changes and successful override. Only the ask's person can replace a named deadline answer within seven days; prior effects are not undone. Digest notices remain internal until a notices read path links them to these rows.

recovery.detail: Retry with the original action id and person-override:{episode}:{answer.id} key. Native override replay does not notify the asker twice.
